description: A quantizer that keeps the octaves a volt apart and re-tunes the twelve notes inside each one by a power function, with a knob that moves the scale between whole families of tunings

params.text: Sets the exponent the scale is built on, 0.01 to 4, starting at 2 where the scale is the Square Root Quantizer's; lower settings flatten it towards equal temperament, higher ones widen the low steps

inputs.text: The pitch to quantize: the whole-volt part is carried through as the octave, and the fractional part is cut into twelve equal steps which are then re-spaced by the power function

outputs.text: The re-tuned pitch; 0V in gives 0V out and each whole volt in moves the output by a whole volt, so octaves keep their spacing while the notes inside them move

notes: a negative input gives 0V at the output, so the module only follows pitches from 0V upwards
with nothing patched into V/OCT the output is held at -1V, an octave below where the other two quantizers rest, so an oscillator fed from it is already playing before any cable is in
the knob carries no lettering on the panel; the maker's tooltip for it reads V/POW

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
